pages.text: The Charter sets pale split stakes along its routes. An amber seam is held between the two halves; the compass answers that seam. These are witness marks, the checkpoints named in a charter.
pages.title: Settled marks
Settle the mark
pages.text: Use them in compass order. The first seals the party. Each settled mark banks part of the guaranteed reward for every member, even if the expedition later fails. Make room before touching one. Its answer can draw company.

pages.title: An unfinished route
pages.text: Death removes a member; losing the last member ends the expedition. Banked tokens remain yours.

pages.title: An unfinished route
pages.text: Disconnecting leaves the route for recovery if its instruments still exist. The last witness mark is not a way home. Follow the new compass bearing to the recall anchor and use it.
